message.reasoning: We need to answer from policy excerpts. The question: "My authenticator app was reinstalled after a phone upgrade and the codes no longer match — how do I re-enrol?" This is about re-enrolling two-factor authentication after losing access to the app. The policy says: from DOC-012 part 2: "From Settings → Security → Two-factor authentication, choose “Reset” and re-enrol the same way as a first-time setup — scanning a new QR code and confirming with a fresh six-digit code. A saved recovery code from the original enrolment can also be used to sign in and reset from there if the settings page itself is not reachable without a working code." Also part 3: "Re-enrolling invalidates the old QR code entirely; only the newly scanned one will generate valid codes afterward." So answer: go to Settings → Security → Two-factor authentication, click Reset, then re-enrol by scanning new QR code, enter code, save recovery codes. If can't reach settings, use recovery code to sign in and reset. Provide short answer.
